sloka: ऋणान्मोचय राजानं मत्कृते भरत प्रभुम् ।पितरं चापि धर्मज्ञं मातरं चाभिनन्दय ॥ २.१०७.१०॥
transliteration: ṛṇānmocaya rājānaṁ matkṛte bharata prabhum ।pitaraṁ cāpi dharmajñaṁ mātaraṁ cābhinandaya ॥ 2.107.10॥

translations.english: O Bharata, release for my sake the competent king from his debt (of vow) and honour the righteous father and the mother as well.
